claim_scope_note: Product-local GUARD-AUGMENTED-WIDENING safety/coverage certificate for the byte-identical installed carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, ALREADY the shipping kernel src/spider/kernel.py). It is the EXACT mandate licensed by request.json#director_mandate.allocation (CONTINUE/REOPEN C-PARAM-INHERIT; parent_handoff_disposition=USE; reason=global-director-CONTINUE). It does NOT re-run the parent support-widening certificate (EXP-PRODUCT-38197856050), does NOT re-run readiness (EXP-PRODUCT-38186502935), does NOT test a substituted carrier, does NOT re-run the excluded mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate, and does NOT fund/run the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark. Measured object: whether a SHIPPED-CANDIDATE, NOT-purely-data-driven applicability guard -- (T-DECLARED-GUARD) an ingested declared grammar with a training-consistency gate and shipped fallback, or (T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD) a purely observational pre-bind refusal of an observationally-ambiguous widened support -- holds ZERO false accepts, ZERO out-of-grammar HTTP executions and ZERO refusal-semantics violations at the frozen 0.8 confidence gate while raising SAFE coverage on an extended seven-family bank (frozen families A-D byte-identical to the parent, new declared families E/F/G), reporting safe+complete vs safe+incomplete per family. Both guards are candidate proposals injected in-run as verification_rule support descriptors; they are NOT shipped, and promotion would require a separate implementation+regression packet. READ-ONLY: the runner never writes src/spider/ or any freeze artifact (proved by V8 clause C over six hashed artifacts). C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays HYPOTHESIS in ALL branches; NO claim advance and NO product promotion is authorized. No economics are measured (model_calls=0, model_tokens=0 by construction).
question: With the now-shipped carrier (src/spider/kernel.py: distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute), can a SHIPPED-CANDIDATE, not-purely-data-driven applicability guard hold M-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT==0 AND M-HTTP-ON-OUT==0 AND M-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT==0 while raising SAFE coverage toward 1.0? Concretely, on an extended bank of seven declared-grammar families on independent localhost 200/404 oracles with a frozen declared-grammar label rule (A item ^item\-[0-9]{3}$, B account ^acct\-[0-9]{4}$, C doc ^doc\-[0-9]{1,4}$, D region ^region\-00[0-9]$ [the pinned subrange where the parent's pure data-driven rule over-accepted 9 ids], E invoice ^invoice\-[0-9]{4}$, F case ^case\-z[a-z]{2}$ [non-digit shared run, NOT observably pinned], G token ^token\-ab[a-z]$ [saturating alpha remainder]): (Q1-IDENTITY) is src/spider/kernel.py byte-identical to the frozen carrier and does the induction path reproduce the EXPECTED_SHIPPED supports for all seven families? (Q2-PRIMARY-MECHANISM) does T-DECLARED-GUARD (ingested declared grammar + training-consistency gate + shipped fallback) bind ZERO out-of-declared-grammar payloads (M-DECLARED-GUARD-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT==0), issue ZERO HTTP on out-of-grammar payloads and never execute a refused case, while reaching M-DECLARED-GUARD-COVERAGE==1.0? (Q3-SECONDARY-MECHANISM) does T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD (purely observational pre-bind refusal of an observationally-ambiguous widening) hold zero false accepts [predicted NO on FAM-F: the non-saturating alpha shared run is absorbed into the widened prefix], i.e. is the observational route a general identifiability limit or a FAM-D artifact? (Q4-BOUNDARY) exactly which families are safe+complete, safe+incomplete, or unsafe under each guard, and does the declared guard preserve the shipped zero-out-of-grammar property at the frozen confidence gate? (Q5-UPPERBOUND) does the raw declared-grammar comparator B-DECLARED-FULL achieve zero false accepts AND coverage 1.0 on the same bank (safe+complete exists)? Report safe+complete vs safe+incomplete per family for both mechanisms. Do NOT re-run the parent widening certificate, do NOT re-run readiness EXP-PRODUCT-38186502935, do NOT test a substituted carrier, and do NOT re-run the excluded mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate.
hypothesis: H1 (primary, constructive): the ingested declared grammar with a training-consistency gate (T-DECLARED-GUARD) holds zero false accepts / zero HTTP-on-OUT / zero refusal executions and reaches coverage 1.0 on the extended bank for every family including pinned FAM-D and the non-pinned FAM-F/FAM-G (safe+complete per family), because the declaration is external sound knowledge and the gate only refuses inconsistent declarations (falling back to the shipped safe support). H2 (secondary, discriminating): the purely observational pre-bind ambiguity refusal (T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD) also holds zero false accepts. Frozen DESIGN point-prediction: H2 is FALSIFIED on FAM-F -- the observational rule widens ^case\-z[a-z]{2}$ to ^case\-[a-z]{3}$ because the shared run 'z' shares the remainder's class and the observed remainder (ab..ij) does NOT saturate the class, so the refusal condition never fires; the OUT ids case-aab/case-bcd/case-xyz and payload case-abc are false-accepted (M-OBSERVATIONAL-GUARD-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT=4). This yields overall decision DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE__OBSERVATIONAL_GUARD_UNSAFE, showing the observational route is a general identifiability limit (purely data-driven widening over-accepts whenever the declaration pins any shared run, digit or alpha) and the declared-grammar route is mandatory. H0 (null): no guard attains zero false accepts with raised coverage, so the shipped over-conservative supports are the ceiling. Frozen value-level point-predictions (pure predicates, no treatment resolve()): B-SHIPPED FA=0 cov=0.6750 (81/120; FR 39); T-DECLARED-GUARD FA=0 cov=1.0; T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD FA=4 cov=0.9167 disposition UNSAFE (refused D,G); B-DATA-WIDENED FA=18 (D9+F4+G5) cov=0.9167; B-DECLARED-FULL FA=0 cov=1.0; PC-UNSAFE-COARSE FA=271; PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN FA=91; BP-DECL-OVERWIDE FA=201; NC-REJECT-ALL 0/0.
falsifier: PRIMARY FALSIFIER: T-DECLARED-GUARD binds >=1 out-of-declared-grammar payload OR issues >=1 HTTP on an out-of-grammar payload OR executes a refused case on a verified carrier -> FALSIFIES (DECLARED_GUARD_UNSAFE), meaning even external declared knowledge cannot be guarded safely on this bank. On the frozen bank this branch is structurally unreachable with SOUND declarations (any false accept would be a bank/mechanism bug, separately anchored by B-SHIPPED FA==0 and B-DECLARED-FULL FA==0/cov==1.0 as validity gates), and it is concretely exercised on the same decision function by the boundary control BP-DECL-OVERWIDE (unsound over-wide declaration passes the gate -> FA=201 -> the identical decision function yields FALSIFIES), so the branch is not vacuous. SECONDARY DISPOSITION (mandatory): if T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD has false_accept_count>0 OR http_on_out_label>0 OR refusal_executed_count>0, M-OBSERVATIONAL-GUARD-DISPOSITION=UNSAFE (FROZEN DESIGN point-prediction: UNSAFE via FAM-F, 4 false accepts), which is a bounded negative about the purely observational mechanism class, NOT the overall packet falsifier and NOT a claim advance; if 0 and coverage==1.0 -> SAFE_AND_COMPLETE; if 0 and coverage<1.0 -> SAFE_INCOMPLETE. Low coverage ALONE (FA==0, FR>0) never falsifies; it maps to MIXED. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (NEVER FALSIFIES) for: shipping kernel sha != 718efa6a (substituted carrier); V8 freeze-binding mismatch; induced shipped support drift (M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY FAIL); M-REGRESSION < 3/3; PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT mismatch; PC-EXACT-REPLAY < 61/61; B-LITERAL-KERNEL unexpectedly exposing distill_parameterized; B-SHIPPED false_accept_count>0 OR B-DECLARED-FULL not (FA==0 and cov==1.0) (bank/label-rule inconsistency); a sensitivity gate failing (PC-UNSAFE-COARSE FA==0 OR PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN FA==0 OR PC-DECL-UNDER adopting any wrong declaration OR NC-REJECT-ALL accept!=0/HTTP!=0); missing git objects or oracle/fixture failure.

positive_control.description: Detector-sensitivity positive control: the SAME installed carrier mechanisms with support replaced by the carrier's OWN coarse fallback sentinel __COARSE__ (accepts any non-empty string without whitespace or '/'). A safety oracle that never fires is useless, so this arm MUST produce at least one false accept on the frozen bank (frozen DESIGN point-prediction: 271, using the carrier's own _support_accepts semantics for __COARSE__). A SECOND sensitivity control PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN replaces support with ^<id_prefix>\-[0-9a-zA-Z]+$ (open width+class) and must also false-accept >=1 OUT (predicted 91), proving the bank discriminates the guard's width/class and not only the coarse fail-open sentinel. A THIRD gate-control PC-DECL-UNDER feeds the declared guard a too-narrow wrong declaration (literal exact-match of train[0]): the training-consistency gate must REFUSE adoption (predicted all-false) and fall back to the shipped support (FA==0), proving the gate is not a rubber stamp. BP-DECL-OVERWIDE feeds a too-wide wrong declaration (^<id_prefix>.*$): training-consistent, so the gate adopts it (predicted all-true) and the arm inherits its own false accepts (predicted FA=201), bounding that declaration soundness is EXTERNAL to the gate.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC-UNSAFE-COARSE false_accept_count >= 1 (predicted 271) AND PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN false_accept_count >= 1 (predicted 91) AND PC-DECL-UNDER adopted==all-false AND PC-DECL-UNDER false_accept_count == 0. If any sensitivity control fails to fire, the safety metric cannot be trusted -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never FALSIFIES). BP-DECL-OVERWIDE is a boundary probe, not a gate: its role is to demonstrate the FALSIFIES branch of the decision function is reachable when the declaration is unsound (reported, not gated).

null_control.description: Null floor: an empty registry (no mechanisms) under the shipped carrier. It must accept nothing and issue no HTTP, anchoring the low end of every false-accept and HTTP-on-OUT metric so the certificate's zero is meaningful (not an artifact of a broken resolver).
null_control.expected_behavior: accept_count == 0 AND http_total == 0. Otherwise the null floor is violated -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never FALSIFIES).

measurement_validity: V1-DETERMINISM: each oracle is a stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:0 (ephemeral port) returning fixed JSON {'type':<resource>,'id':<id>,'data':'res:'+<id>} 200 iff /api/<resource_plural>/<declared id> matches the family declared grammar, else 404; no RNG, no wall-clock, no external network, no model. All guard rules are pure functions of the frozen training ids; the whole evaluation runs twice and asserts identical declared/ambiguity/data-widened/shipped/declared-full metrics, identical support identity and identical mechanism identity (port-invariant; mechanism_id excluded).

V2-CREDENTIAL-FREE + MODEL-FREE: no model calls and no browser actions; only loopback 127.0.0.1. The oracle's request counter is the authoritative HTTP measure (http_delta per record). model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0 by construction.

V3-IDENTITY-PREMISE-GATE: src/spider/kernel.py must have sha256 == CARRIER_SHA256 718efa6a... on a git-clean tree. Any other state (e.g. literal 46929b3a...) means the carrier was substituted -> BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact reason, NEVER FALSIFIES.

V4-STOP-TRIGGER (parent handoff do_not_assume): if the shipping-path identity is not the frozen carrier, or the induced shipped supports differ from the frozen EXPECTED_SHIPPED constants, or the widened/ambiguity supports differ from the frozen DESIGN constants, the runner stops BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID before any outcome measurement; the bank is never measured against a substituted/drifted carrier and the parent certificate/readiness measurement is never re-run.

V5-BANK-CONSTRUCTIBILITY + LABEL RULE (frozen, DESIGN-validated): 524 unique-bid items. Ground-truth label rule: IN iff value is a str fullmatching the family declared regex AND intent == family intent AND context == {resource_type:<resource>,authenticated:true} AND params == {<resource>: value}; otherwise OUT. DESIGN validation: 120 IN / 404 OUT; FAM-A 16/56, FAM-B 18/55, FAM-C 19/53, FAM-D 10/65, FAM-E 16/55, FAM-F 12/61, FAM-G 29/59; the OUT set spans wrong-length, alpha, hex, case, separator, whitespace, injection, query/fragment/percent, unicode, other-prefix, oversized, non-string types, context/intent/param mismatch, and wrong-subrange same-class ids (FAM-D region-010..999, FAM-F case-aab/bcd/xyz + alpha ones, FAM-G token-aaa..zzz) that widened/guarded rules are expected to treat differently.

V6-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS: every refusal must have bound_action None, a non-empty reason, status != EXECUTABLE and ZERO HTTP (http_delta == 0). refusal_executed_count counts OUT items with status != EXECUTABLE and http_delta > 0 and MUST be 0 (structural invariant of resolve(): bound_action is only set on EXECUTABLE). Any violation is a validity anomaly.

V7-BOUNDARY-HONESTY: the packet reports per-family safety and coverage separately and never conflates 'safe' (false_accept_count == 0) with 'complete' (coverage == 1.0); both guard supports per family and the exact false-accept bids are reported.

V8-FREEZE-BINDING (EXECUTE mode): (A) sha256(prereg.md) == freeze.json.hashes['prereg.md']; (B) the running orchestration source (__file__) equals the FROZEN RUNNER block inside the hash-bound prereg.md (normalized only for trailing newline and CRLF); (C) sha256 of EVERY artifact in freeze.json.artifact_hashes matches (SIX artifacts incl. src/spider/kernel.py, never mutated). Missing freeze.json in EXECUTE mode, or any mismatch, is BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Probe mode (EXP_PROBE_MODE=1) records UNBOUND-RUN and never fabricates the check.

V9-REGRESSION: tests/test_kernel.py must pass 3/3 on the as-installed shipping path with src on sys.path. A discovery result with < 3 tests or any failure/error is a validity gate failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

V10-ABLATION-ATTRIBUTION: B-LITERAL-KERNEL is loaded from the frozen literal git blob in a hermetic temp package with the same shipped models/registry/init; if it exposes distill_parameterized the attribution logic is broken and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V11-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY (non-vacuous oracle): PC-UNSAFE-COARSE FA >= 1 AND PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN FA >= 1 AND PC-DECL-UNDER adopted==all-false AND NC-REJECT-ALL accept_count == 0 AND http_total == 0; otherwise the certificate's zero is uninformative and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

V12-TREATMENT-EQUIVALENCE (why support override == guard inference): mechanism_id is a hash of {intent, template, slots} and is INDEPENDENT of the support descriptor; the only support-dependent downstream behaviour is verification_rule['parameter_supports'] consumed by resolve()'s _support_accepts. Replacing each induced support with the guard rule's output is therefore exactly equivalent to re-running distill_parameterized with its internal _infer_support replaced by the guard rule (verified at DESIGN by the real-carrier induction probe: 7/7 families induce the expected single-slot mechanism at confidence 0.9), while keeping the shipped bytes untouched.

V13-BANK/LABEL CONSISTENCY ANCHORS: B-SHIPPED false_accept_count == 0 AND B-DECLARED-FULL (raw declaration injected) false_accept_count == 0 AND coverage == 1.0 are validity gates: because the label rule and the declared support are the SAME grammar, any mismatch is a bank construction bug -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a treatment result.

decision_rule.primary_metric: M-DECLARED-GUARD-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT (T-DECLARED-GUARD count of OUT-labelled bank items whose resolve() status == EXECUTABLE), co-primary M-DECLARED-GUARD-HTTP-ON-OUT (total HTTP issued on OUT-labelled items) and M-DECLARED-GUARD-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT (refused items that nonetheless issued HTTP), with M-DECLARED-GUARD-COVERAGE (declared IN items bound / 120).
secondary_metrics: M-B-DATA-WIDENED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT / -COVERAGE (parent comparator on the extended bank)

gates.validity_gate: ALL of V8-FREEZE-BINDING, M-IDENTITY, M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY, M-REGRESSION (3/3), PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT, PC-EXACT-REPLAY (61/61), B-LITERAL-KERNEL, B-SHIPPED (FA==0) and B-DECLARED-FULL (FA==0 AND coverage==1.0) must PASS; otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE (instrument failure, never a negative).
gates.sensitivity_gate: PC-UNSAFE-COARSE false_accept_count >= 1 AND PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN false_accept_count >= 1 AND PC-DECL-UNDER adopted == all-false AND PC-DECL-UNDER false_accept_count == 0 AND NC-REJECT-ALL accept_count == 0 AND NC-REJECT-ALL http_total == 0; otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE (vacuous/blind oracle or rubber-stamp gate).

DECLARED_GUARD_UNSAFE.outcome: FALSIFIES (status=COMPLETE): even the ingested declared grammar cannot be guarded safely on this bank; no widening of any kind is licensed. Unreachable with the frozen SOUND declarations on the main bank; the identical decision function is demonstrated to fire by BP-DECL-OVERWIDE (unsound declaration, predicted FA=201).

DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE__OBSERV.definition: T-DECLARED-GUARD false_accept_count == 0 AND http_on_out_label == 0 AND refusal_executed_count == 0 AND coverage == 1.0; <DISP> ∈ {SAFE_AND_COMPLETE, SAFE_INCOMPLETE, UNSAFE} is the mandatory disposition of T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD.
DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE__OBSERV.outcome: SUPPORTS (status=COMPLETE) unless <DISP>==UNSAFE, in which case SUPPORTS is still returned with the bounded observational negative carried in the decision string (the mandate's existence question -- a not-purely-data-driven guard holding zero false accepts while raising safe coverage -- is answered YES by the declared-grammar route, and the purely observational route is separately bounded UNSAFE). Frozen DESIGN prediction: decision = DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE__OBSERVATIONAL_GUARD_UNSAFE (FAM-F 4 false accepts under the widened ^case\-[a-z]{3}$).

DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE__OBSE.definition: T-DECLARED-GUARD safe (all three safety metrics 0) but coverage < 1.0.
DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE__OBSE.outcome: MIXED (status=COMPLETE): the declared guard is safe but leaves declared ids refused (e.g., any family whose declaration the gate refuses, falling back to shipped -- the PC-DECL-UNDER branch of the decision function); report the per-family shortfall versus B-DECLARED-FULL.

decision_rule.overall_outcome_mapping: Precedence: MEASUREMENT_INVALID > FALSIFIES > (SUPPORTS vs MIXED). status=BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID if V8/identity/support-identity/bank-consistency/validity/sensitivity/infrastructure fails (never a negative). Else status=COMPLETE with outcome FALSIFIES (DECLARED_GUARD_UNSAFE) if the declared guard has any false accept / out-of-grammar HTTP / executed refusal; SUPPORTS if the declared guard is safe and coverage==1.0 (decision string carries the mandatory M-OBSERVATIONAL-GUARD-DISPOSITION); otherwise MIXED (DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE__OBSERVATIONAL_GUARD_<DISP>).

decision_rule.reachability: The outcome mapping is total and branches are distinguishable measurements. SUPPORTS is the frozen DESIGN point-prediction (T-DECLARED-GUARD FA=0 cov=1.0, value-level probe) and is concretely reachable. The secondary UNSAFE disposition is reachable and predicted (T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD FA=4, all FAM-F: FF-OG-ALPHA-ALL=case-abc, FF-OG-WRONGRANGE00=case-aab, 01=case-bcd, 02=case-xyz; PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN independently shows the same metric fires). MIXED is reachable in the same decision function (0 FA + coverage<1; PC-DECL-UNDER feeds a too-narrow declaration that the gate refuses -> shipped fallback -> FA=0, coverage<1, exercising the identical DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE branch). FALSIFIES is reachable in the same decision function via BP-DECL-OVERWIDE (unsound declaration adopted -> FA=201 -> DECLARED_GUARD_UNSAFE) and via any future unsound declaration input; with the frozen SOUND declarations it is structurally excluded by the gate's own premise, so both directions of the gate (refuse-or-adopt) are exercised by controls rather than assumed. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via substituted carrier, support drift, tampered freeze artifact, bank/label inconsistency (B-SHIPPED/B-DECLARED-FULL anchors), or a failing validity/sensitivity gate. DESIGN probes (value-level predicates and the real-carrier induction path only; NO treatment resolve() over the bank was run in DESIGN) confirmed: shipped/widened/ambiguity/declared supports for all 7 families; bank 524 items/120 IN/404 OUT/unique bids; arm arithmetic above; 7/7 induced mechanisms at confidence 0.9 with expected supports; 61/61 training ids fullmatch every arm support.
decision_rule.claim_status_semantics: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL and C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS in ALL branches. A SUPPORTS/DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE result is a bounded Product-local positive for a shipped-candidate applicability guard (the ingested declared grammar with a consistency gate), licensing a separate implementation+regression packet before any shipped change; an OBSERVATIONAL_GUARD_UNSAFE disposition is a bounded negative about the purely observational mechanism class (the parent's FAM-D identifiability limit generalizes to non-digit shared runs), NOT a claim advance and NOT a gateway discharge: the registered next_gate (the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT comparison) remains unmet and unfunded. No branch advances or promotes any claim.

product_consequence_positive: If T-DECLARED-GUARD is safe+complete (FA==0, HTTP-on-OUT==0, coverage 1.0) on the extended bank including FAM-D and the non-pinned FAM-F/FAM-G, the shipped carrier can raise safe coverage from 0.6750 (81/120) to 1.0 by ingesting declared applicability grammars with a training-consistency gate and shipped fallback, preserving the zero-out-of-grammar property at the frozen 0.8 confidence gate. This is the constructive product path: ship the declared-grammar ingestion guard (subject to a separate implementation+regression packet) and strengthen the treatment arm before the flagship cold/instructions/retrieval benchmark; the B-DECLARED-FULL comparator proves the safe+complete support exists and the gate controls prove the mechanism refuses inconsistent declarations.
product_consequence_negative: If T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD is UNSAFE (frozen prediction: FAM-F over-accepts 4 ids because the non-saturating alpha shared run hides the pinning), the purely observational pre-bind refusal does NOT generalize beyond the saturating-digit case, so the product must NOT ship widening without an external declared grammar: the observational ambiguity of a pinned shared run is a general identifiability limit (digit or alpha), and any automatically widened support on an undocumented grammar stays unsafe; the carrier ships conservative (over-narrow supports) until a declared grammar is available. If T-DECLARED-GUARD itself is unsafe (FALSIFIES), no widening of any kind is licensed. BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID -> the question cannot be assessed; the exact operational blocker is recorded (substituted carrier, support drift, freeze-binding mismatch, bank/label inconsistency, missing git objects, vacuous controls). Infrastructure/measurement failure is never repackaged as a scientific negative. In every branch C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays HYPOTHESIS, and the four-arm benchmark remains unfunded.

estimated_cost.network_requests: 0 external; loopback 127.0.0.1 only. Per evaluation run: 61 induction GETs (5 A/B/C/E/F + 10 D + 26 G) + one GET per structurally-bound item per arm (T-DECLARED-GUARD 120, T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD ~110, B-DATA-WIDENED ~110, B-SHIPPED ~81, B-DECLARED-FULL 120, PC-UNSAFE-COARSE ~120, PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN ~120, PC-DECL-UNDER ~81, BP-DECL-OVERWIDE ~120, NC-REJECT-ALL 0); the whole run executes twice for determinism, so roughly 2x that. No download, no credentials.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-relevant in both directions, and the smallest decisive Product-local batch on the shipped bytes that directly answers the Director's CONTINUE/REOPEN question. It is the first measurement to test a NOT-purely-data-driven applicability guard on the shipped resolve()/execute() path: an ingested declared grammar with a training-consistency gate (primary) versus a purely observational pre-bind ambiguity refusal (secondary), on an extended seven-family bank that reproduces the four frozen families, re-measures the parent widening rule as a comparator, adds a pinned non-digit declared grammar (FAM-F, shared run NOT observably pinned) and a saturating-alpha grammar (FAM-G), with per-family safe/complete decomposition, THREE gate/sensitivity controls, a boundary probe, a null floor and a declared-grammar ceiling. It changes a concrete decision: DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE -> the declared-grammar ingestion guard is licensed for a separate implementation packet (coverage 0.6750 -> 1.0 while holding zero false accepts); OBSERVATIONAL_GUARD_UNSAFE -> purely observational widening is abandoned as a general identifiability limit, closing the parent's named unknown (whether the FAM-D negative was one-class or universal); FALSIFIES -> no widening at all. Either way it does not fund or advance the externally gated four-arm benchmark.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The outcome mapping is total and every branch is concretely reachable by the frozen decision function. SUPPORTS is the frozen DESIGN point-prediction (T-DECLARED-GUARD FA=0 cov=1.0, value-level probe over the runner's own label_of/guard rules). The secondary UNSAFE disposition is reachable AND predicted: T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD false-accepts 4 FAM-F items (case-abc, case-aab, case-bcd, case-xyz) under the widened ^case\-[a-z]{3}$; PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN independently proves the same metric can fire (FA=91). MIXED is reachable in the same decision function via PC-DECL-UNDER (a too-narrow declaration is refused by the gate -> shipped fallback -> safe but coverage<1, exercising DECLARED_GUARD_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE). FALSIFIES is reachable in the same decision function via BP-DECL-OVERWIDE (unsound over-wide declaration passes the training-consistency gate -> adoption -> FA=201 -> the identical decision expression emits DECLARED_GUARD_UNSAFE), so the negative branch is not vacuous; on the main bank the FALSIFIES branch is structurally excluded because the frozen inputs are SOUND declarations (any false accept there would be a bank bug, anchored by the B-SHIPPED/B-DECLARED-FULL validity gates). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via substituted carrier, support drift, tampered freeze artifact, bank/label inconsistency, or a failing validity/sensitivity gate. No branch is empty or arithmetically impossible.

baseline_identifiability.reason: All arms are structurally distinct objects built from the SAME seven frozen induced mechanisms: T-DECLARED-GUARD rewrites each support to declared_guard_support(train, declaration, shipped) (gate + fallback); T-AMBIGUITY-GUARD rewrites each support to ambiguity_guard_support(train, shipped, widened) (observational refusal; refuses D and G, widens A/B/C/E/F); B-DATA-WIDENED rewrites to widen_support(train) (parent rule; differs from the ambiguity guard exactly on D and G); B-SHIPPED leaves the induced supports; B-DECLARED-FULL rewrites to the raw declared grammar WITHOUT the gate (ceiling); PC-UNSAFE-COARSE rewrites to the shipped __COARSE__ sentinel; PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN rewrites to ^<id_prefix>\-[0-9a-zA-Z]+$; NC-REJECT-ALL uses an empty registry; B-LITERAL-KERNEL is a DIFFERENT frozen git blob lacking distill_parameterized. Because every permissive arm is the identical mechanism objects with ONLY verification_rule['parameter_supports'] changed, any difference in false-accept/coverage is attributable to the support descriptor alone (V12 proves mechanism_id is support-independent). T-DECLARED-GUARD and B-DECLARED-FULL coincide on the main bank BY DESIGN (the gate adopts every SOUND declaration, and the labels are defined by those same declarations); the gate's existence is established by PC-DECL-UNDER (refuses, falls back to shipped) and BP-DECL-OVERWIDE (cannot detect unsoundness, adopts, inherits FA), so the treatment is separable from the ceiling through its distinctive behavior on inconsistent inputs. The carrier bytes are pinned by explicit sha256, the M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY gate (shipped AND widened AND ambiguity supports == frozen constants), and the V8 artifact hashes, so no unbound mutable code can masquerade as any arm.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every gated control has a concrete, reachable failure mode on the exact code path that produces the certificate: PC-EXACT-REPLAY fails (<61/61) if the carrier cannot rebind its own identity on the seven induced mechanisms; PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT fails if two runs diverge; M-REGRESSION fails if the package surface drifts; M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY fails on induction drift for any of the seven families; B-LITERAL-KERNEL fails if the literal blob unexpectedly exposes distill_parameterized; V8 fails on any prereg/runner/artifact hash mismatch. The safety oracle is proven sensitive by TWO independent fail-open arms required to fire (PC-UNSAFE-COARSE DESIGN value-level probe 271 false accepts using the carrier's own __COARSE__ semantics; PC-OVERWIDE-OPEN 91 false accepts), by the gate's own sensitivity control PC-DECL-UNDER (adopted must be all-false, FA==0; proven by value-level probe) and by NC-REJECT-ALL (accept nothing, no HTTP). The boundary probe BP-DECL-OVERWIDE fires (adopted all-true, FA=201) proving the FALSIFIES branch of the decision function is live. A detector that never fires would yield a meaningless zero false-accept count, so all these requirements are pre-established by probe.
evidence_refs: DESIGN value-level probe: __COARSE__ FA=271 and open-width FA=91 and gate-refusal FA=0 -> sensitivity margin >> 0 by construction; BP-DECL-OVERWIDE FA=201 demonstrates the negative branch

treatment_liveness.reason: Both treatments are structurally live on the SAME credential-free substrate class: the REAL-CARRIER induction-path probe (DESIGN, non-outcome) reproduced for all seven families a single-slot parameterized mechanism at confidence 0.9 (>= frozen min_confidence 0.8) with supports exactly equal to EXPECTED_SHIPPED; all 61 training ids fullmatch the shipped, widened, declared and ambiguity supports, so every arm binds every training id (PC-EXACT-REPLAY 61/61 expected). Liveness is inherited for the underlying carrier (EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830 promoted it after D1-D4; EXP-PRODUCT-38186502935 ran the full shipped path end-to-end with an independent audit PASS). Because both guards only rewrite the support descriptor (V12), a widened/declared support that is a strict superset of the shipped support cannot reduce liveness on the training ids; a silently dead treatment is caught by the PC-EXACT-REPLAY 61/61 gate -> BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a negative. The treatment bytes are frozen by sha256 + freeze-artifact hashes.
